Chronic use of corticosteroids, which are anti-inﬂ ammatory 
and immune-suppressing medications, is a mainstay of treat-
ment for several medical conditions, including rheumatoid
arthritis, COPD, and others. Th is class of medications results 
in decreased absorption of calcium from the GI tract as well as 
increased urinary loss of calcium. Th is signiﬁ cant drug con-
sequence places the patient at high risk for bone fracture and 
osteoporosis.48
